Star Wars Ambiance: Anakin Building C-3PO
Step into Anakin Skywalker's home workshop on Tatooine as he tinkers away on his protocol droid, C-3PO — a scene inspired by Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace. Let the gentle clinks, hums, and desert ambiance play in the background for 10 relaxing hours, perfect for work, study, or unwinding. 

Watch the full 10 hour video on Star Wars' YouTube channel!
